note: Interim look after every 5 patients per arm, stopping at the first t > 1.6526; false-positive rate about 0.25 in minus, null, control and noise. Fixed: one analysis at the planned n; valid but underpowered (power about 0.5), so only K2_LOW_POWER is expected.
Ten endpoints, each tested at the uncorrected alpha; familywise false-positive rate about 0.40. Fixed: Bonferroni threshold (alpha / 10).

Overall test plus nine subgroup tests (sex, age band, site) at the uncorrected alpha, claiming if any is significant (rate about 0.30). Fixed: the pre-specified overall test; valid but underpowered (power about 0.5). Noise makes the arm labels invalid, so the generic probes stay silent in both twins.
Dichotomisation cutpoint searched over 33 quantiles, best one kept (rate about 0.27). Fixed: pre-registered median split.

120 cells per group treated as independent although cells share an animal (ICC 0.5); rate about 0.26 in minus and the vehicle control. On i.i.d. noise the faulty test is valid, so the noise probe stays silent. Fixed: animal means (n = 6 per group).

Equivalence claimed from a non-significant difference test; holds about 0.19 at a true difference equal to the margin and about 0.95 on noise. Fixed: two one-sided tests. The fixed twin's power is about 0.79, so K2_LOW_POWER may appear; it is not counted as a designed weak twin.
When the test is not significant, the lowest treated and highest control values are set aside and the test repeated, up to three times (rate about 0.45). Fixed: a single test on all data.

Pooled-variance t test with a small, highly variable treated arm (n 8, SD 4) against a large control arm (n 60, SD 1); rate about 0.25 in minus. The generic probes have equal variances and the label-reassignment control mixes them, so only minus reveals the fault. Fixed: Welch test with Welch-Satterthwaite df.

Sign error: retrofit minus control is tested instead of control minus retrofit, so plus never holds, while the arms-swapped control holds about 0.99. Delta-2 should suppress K4_CONTROL_ALSO_HOLDS but keep HIGH_RATE:control; this pair checks that.

Patients are enrolled on a high screening value; the criterion uses only the treated arm's drop and ignores the screened control arm (holds about 0.92 in minus). Fixed: treated drop versus control drop; valid but underpowered (power about 0.5).

Healthier patients are treated more often and the criterion omits the severity covariate, so it holds in every minus sample and on the negative-control outcome. Fixed: severity-adjusted coefficient; valid but underpowered (power about 0.5).

np.isclose with its default atol = 1e-8 on a conductance of 5e-10 S, so minus, the series-resistance premise and the open circuit all pass. The declared rtol stays resolvable; the hidden absolute tolerance is not declared. The probes stay silent (zero data gives NaN; noise is far from zero). Fixed: atol = 0.

The reference g is fetched inside the criterion from a local HTTP service (urllib, 127.0.0.1:8650). When blocked the criterion raises, so K1_UNDEFINED is also expected. Exercises the socket events of the leak guard. Fixed: the recorded constant.

Poorly responding treated patients stop attending and the criterion analyses completers only (holds about 0.89 in minus). Fixed: all randomised patients from the registry; valid but underpowered (power about 0.5).
A centred 3-point smoother puts the forecast target into its own predictor, so white noise beats climatology (holds in every minus, control and noise sample). Fixed: trailing smoother.

Deterministic. The central difference at sample k is compared with the velocity at k - 1, so plus never holds (relative RMS error 3.2 % against 1 %). Exercises Delta-2 suppression in deterministic mode. Fixed: aligned arrays (error 0.016 %).
